product.name: ScrubiMail
product.description: ScrubiMail is a powerful email validation SaaS that helps developers and businesses verify email addresses, reduce bounce rates, and improve deliverability.
use_cases: Validate email addresses during user signup
Clean email marketing lists before campaigns
Detect disposable and temporary email addresses
Verify email syntax, DNS records, and SMTP servers
Reduce bounce rates and protect sender reputation
Prevent fake registrations and improve data quality
features: Detailed validation results with confidence scores
advantages: Affordable pricing for startups and enterprises

quick_start.description: Get started with ScrubiMail in minutes
steps: Get your API key from the dashboard
Make your first API call to validate an email
Review the validation results and integrate into your app

example_code.curl:
curl -X POST https://api.scrubimail.com/validate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email": "test@example.com"}'
